summary: Viking Acquisition Corp. I filed an 8-K reporting results of its extraordinary general meeting held on September 2, 2026, in connection with its proposed business combination with NorthStar Earth Space Inc. The filing is a routine disclosure of shareholder vote outcomes (Item 5.07) and other events (Item 8.01). It does not announce the transaction itself, which was previously disclosed via a definitive proxy statement/prospectus. No new deal terms, pricing, or recommendations are provided beyond the voting results. As a special-situations event, the business combination was already known; this filing merely confirms shareholder approval and procedural matters.
